findings.claim: The hospital's page ends at sign-in: no console page connects a hospital's data and no 'to finish' list exists, so the data connection is still the vendor's command-line step (RUNBOOK section 1 step 4, section 18); the page needs the owner's 'connect your data' step when the new lane K card for the 'to finish' list lands

The set-up page still asks more than the owner's four install answers (language, hospital name, the owner's account, the passphrase without a TPM); the hospital's page says 'answer the questions on the page' until HS-4 lands
No 'use the placeholder hospital' button on a PoC box (HS-9); the hospital's page says only that a demonstration box never needs real patient data

The installer's stop lines quoted on the hospital's page are English only on the ja and zh-TW pages, and five are not plain: bootstrap's bundle-signature line names the key's path, box-install's Docker line names box-prepare.sh and --pub and a RUNBOOK section, 'the install stopped' names install.log, 'the set-up is not finished' names deploy/.env and --firstrun, and the code-voided line is not a sentence (HS-5)

docs/handover/it-one-page.en.md (generated by tools/it_one_page.py) still names TB_TLS_HOSTNAME (design row 51); the runbook readers test test_it_has_one_page_in_each_language asserts the name is there, so removing it needs the integrator's ruling
The hospital's page gives 500 GB free, the only disk figure the runbook gives for a box (RUNBOOK section 27); no installer step checks a figure, and card H-95 changes it
No step of the hospital's page has been walked on a box or a fake host: the page follows the installer's code and the HS-1 branch's launcher, not a run
